title: Chapter 78 Developing The New Wasteland City
content:
Chapter 78 Developing The New Wasteland City

In place, Qin Yi and others looked at the giant city in front of them that was somewhat similar to the deserted city in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm, but were very different, and they were all stunned.

At the same time, they also understood what Lu Daosheng said just now that this place will be the land of the deserted city.

It seems that this is the city lord who wants to expand his power again.

"What do you think of this city?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked back and looked at everyone and said with a smile.

Hearing this, everyone praised repeatedly: "This city's divine light is so grand that it is absolutely extraordinary."

"Since it is the property of the city lord, it must be the supreme treasure."

"Dad, I knew you still have stock."

Listening to everyone's words, Lu Daosheng continued, "From now on, this giant city will be handed over to you for the time being."

"Don't you want to avenge the Realm Alliance? Then work hard on your own."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng threw a ring to Qin Yi.

The resources inside are enough for these people to use for a long time.

"Remember, you three forces no longer exist, don't forget your current identities."

They are no longer the Human Emperor Palace, the Heavenly Court and the Holy Gate, but people from the deserted city.

Upon hearing this, Qin Yi and others focused and said, "I'll understand."

The city lord actually handed over such a giant city to them, which shows how much Lu Daosheng values them. Since this is the case, he and others will definitely not disappoint Lu Daosheng.

On the side, Lu Xue looked at Lu Daosheng with a little hesitant expression, but finally said, "Dad, can I stay here too?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

"You want to stay here too?"

Lu Xue nodded.

It seemed as if Lu Xue was seeing what she was thinking, but Lu Daosheng did not refuse, but hesitated.

"You stay here, what if something happens?"

As soon as these words were said, the next moment, Ao Qing's head poked out from Lu Xue's cuff.

"Master, I think I can,"

"Shut up."

Lu Daosheng glared at Ao Qing, and Ao Qing quickly shrank his head back.

Looking at his daughter, Lu Daosheng finally agreed after a long time of silence.

After all, with his own ability, Lu Xue will never have any trouble if he wants to travel between two deserted cities.

Besides, Lu Xue has her own backhand. Looking at the entire star field, who can hurt her daughter?

Looking back at Qin Yi and others, "Take good care of Xiaoxue and don't let her suffer."

"Master Lord, let's remember it."

Just kidding, that's the pearl in the city lord's hand, who dares to mess with it?

But Qin Yi was very happy inside.

No matter how you say that the other party is also the successor of the Human Emperor Palace he designated.

Although it seems that the other party does not take the Human Emperor Palace seriously at all, the identity of the Human Emperor Palace is enough for him.

Buzz —

The city gate opened, and Lu Daosheng led everyone into the new deserted city.

Suddenly, the pictures in the city shocked Qin Yi and others again.

At this moment, they finally understood what it means to look at the sky in a well.

At the same time, they could not imagine how this giant city was built, and their strength limited their imagination.

Looking towards the center of the city, a small town floating in the sky like a city in the city.

Is the city lord's mansion there?

At this time, Qin Yi and others looked extremely solemn.

They have already felt a lot of pressure at this moment.

Next, they have to develop this place well, after all, they can't waste such precious resources.

After laying out some restrictions, the entire deserted city was shrouded in a layer of mysterious power, Lu Daosheng stopped and said, "Except for some places that cannot be stepped into, you can use them all over the city."

If you practice here, as long as you are not a fool, you will definitely become a peerless strong man.

Then without waiting for Qin Yi and others to reply, Lu Daosheng looked at Lu Xue next to him and smiled, "Xiaoxue, if you don't want to stay here, just say it to your father, do you know?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

"I know, dad."

"Well, then okay, that dad is gone."

Immediately, under the gaze of Lu Xue, Qin Yi and others, Lu Daosheng left the city directly.

After a moment.

"Miss, do you have any instructions?"

At this time, Xu Qingzhi took the initiative to go forward and said.

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue waved her hand, "Didn't my father say that, just let you develop yourself, you don't have to worry about me."

Hearing Lu Xue's words, Xu Qingzhi nodded.

But everyone did not relax their vigilance against Lu Xue, because Lu Daosheng had told him secretly before leaving, don’t let Lu Xue leave the city.

Lu Xue can do anything in this city, as long as Lu Xue doesn't go out.

After Lu Xue left, everyone looked at Qin Yi, and to be precise, they looked at the ring in Qin Yi's hand.

That was left to them by Lu Daosheng.

"Who is surnamed Qin, why are you still standing there?"

Xu Qingzhi looked at Qin Yi and said directly that the attitude comparison and Lu Xue were a major change.

Hearing this, Qin Yi glared at Xu Qingzhi, and then his spiritual sense penetrated into the ring.

The next moment, he was stunned.

At this moment, there was only one sentence in his mind that kept echoing.

Poverty limits imagination.

What kind of life did I live before?

On the side, Xu Qingzhi and Muchen frowned, and then Xu Qingzhi stepped forward and snatched the ring, "I said, what are you dithering about, you don't want to embezzle it, do you?"

Then, Xu Qingzhi also looked into the ring out of curiosity.

The Lord of the City should have left them a lot of things.

Buzz——

Instantly, Xu Qingzhi's eyes were directly absent-minded.

Was he dazzled?

Seeing the two of them like this, Muchen on the side was speechless. So many subordinates were watching, can you be more promising.

"Give it to me!"

Muchen took the ring from Xu Qingzhi's hand and took a deep breath.

Although the two were unreliable, they would not be so exaggerated, so it must be that the things in the ring were beyond their imagination.

After making enough psychological preparations, Muchen also looked into the ring.

"Ga~"

Even though he was mentally prepared, Muchen still underestimated the resources in the ring.

How many resources are there here? Mu Chen took a quick look and thought that it could probably train 10,000 strong people like them.

It's really not an exaggeration. This is still a rough estimate.

Around, Ye Qing and others looked at each other. What happened to the three adults?

Sure enough, people's joys and sorrows are not connected, and this is the case at this moment.

After a long time, Qin Yi and the other two finally recovered and were ecstatic.

They are rich! They are rich!

Now they have everything they need, except time. In fact, even time has been greatly shortened with so many resources.

Jiemeng, right? Wait, we are coming soon.

At this time, outside the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng stood in the starry sky and watched silently.

He has not left yet. Such a big city is left to Qin Yi and others. Although he is invincible and has absolute confidence, he still needs to observe.

Seeing Qin Yi and the others rushing to practice, Lu Daosheng nodded and then looked at Lu Xue.

At this time, Lu Xue was still visiting everywhere in the city.
